description: PB-41 is the Regional Transport Office (RTO) serving the Sultanpur Lodhi subdivision in the Kapurthala district of Punjab. It is an SDM-level RTO responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and the enforcement of the Motor Vehicles Act within its jurisdiction.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Sultanpur Lodhi, District Kapurthala, Punjab
